questions.question: Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct? 40 - 15 / 5 × 3 + 6 = 21 ?
questions.questionHtml:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

40 - 15 / 5 × 3 + 6 = 21 ?
questions.solution:
Option 4) / and ×

40 - 15 / 5 × 3 + 6 = 21 ⇒ 40 - 15 × 5 / 3 + 6 = 21

⇒ 40 - 15 × 5 / 3 + 6 = 21 ⇒ 40 - 15 × 1.67 + 6 = 21 ⇒ 40 + 6 - 25 = 21 ⇒ 46 - 25 = 21 ⇒ 21 = 21 (LHS = RHS)

questions.question: Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option. Statement: The successful deployment of the new quantum satellite has provided empirical evidence for long-distance entanglement, but it also creates opportunities for developing unhackable global communication networks. Assumptions: I. Quantum satellites offer a new method for global communication. II. The theory of entanglement has been fully utilized by this deployment. III. Further research into quantum entanglement will lead to breakthroughs in cybersecurity. ?
questions.questionHtml:
Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option.

Statement: The successful deployment of the new quantum satellite has provided empirical evidence for long-distance entanglement, but it also creates opportunities for developing unhackable global communication networks.

Assumptions:

I. Quantum satellites offer a new method for global communication.

II. The theory of entanglement has been fully utilized by this deployment.

III. Further research into quantum entanglement will lead to breakthroughs in cybersecurity. ?

options.text: Only I and II are implicit
options.html: Only I and II are implicit

options.text: Only II and III are implicit
options.html: Only II and III are implicit

options.text: Only I and III are implicit
options.html: Only I and III are implicit

options.text: All I, II, and III are implicit
options.html: All I, II, and III are implicit

questions.solution:
I. Quantum satellites offer a new method for global communication. ⇒ Implicit

The statement links the satellite's development to opportunities for global communication networks, which presumes that quantum satellite can be used as a communication method. 

II. The theory of entanglement has been fully utilized by this deployment. ⇒ Not Implicit

The statement does not suggest that the theory of entanglement has been fully utilized, only that that the evidence has been demonstrated. 

III. Further research into quantum entanglement will lead to breakthroughs in cybersecurity. ⇒ Implicit

The statement mentions that unhackable global communication networks assumes that further development of quantum entanglement will contribute to advance in cybersecurity.

Thus, Only I and III are implicit.

questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: More households purchased electric vehicles this year compared to last year. Conclusions: I. Electric vehicles are becoming the preferred choice for families. II. Traditional fuel-based cars are no longer being manufactured. ?
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: More households purchased electric vehicles this year compared to last year.

Conclusions:

I. Electric vehicles are becoming the preferred choice for families.

II. Traditional fuel-based cars are no longer being manufactured. ?
questions.solution:
I. Electric vehicles are becoming the preferred choice for families.. ⇒ True

An increase in sales supports the trend of electric vehicles becoming a preferred choice.

II. Traditional fuel-based cars are no longer being manufactured. ⇒ False

This is completely unrelated and not supported by the statement.

Thus, Only Conclusion I follows.

questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: All metals are solids. Some solids are hard materials. Conclusions: I. Some metals are hard materials. II. All hard materials are metals. ?
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: All metals are solids. Some solids are hard materials.

Conclusions: I. Some metals are hard materials.

II. All hard materials are metals. ?
questions.solution:
Conclusions:

I. Some metals are hard materials → Does not follow (As all metals are solids and some solids are hard materials. So it is possible but not definite)

II. All hard materials are metals → Does not follow (As all metals are solids and some solids are hard materials. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Neither I nor II follows.

questions.question: Find the letter which is located exactly between the 2nd and 5th letters of the following word as per the English alphabetical series. BREAD ?
questions.questionHtml: Find the letter which is located exactly between the 2nd and 5th letters of the following word as per the English alphabetical series. BREAD ?
questions.solution:
2nd letter of word → BREAD → R (18)

5th letter of word → BREAD → D (4)

So, the letter which is located exactly between the 2nd and 5th letters → [R(18) + D(4)] ÷ 2 → 22 ÷ 2 = 11th letter i.e. K

questions.question: If 6 @ 2 = 38 and 3 @ 4 = 13, then what is the value of 5 @ 3?
questions.questionHtml: If 6 @ 2 = 38 and 3 @ 4 = 13, then what is the value of 5 @ 3?
questions.solution:
6 @ 2 = 38 → (6)2 + 2 ⇒ 36 + 2 = 38

3 @ 4 = 13 → (3)2 + 4 ⇒ 9 + 4 = 13

5 @ 3 → (5)2 + 3 ⇒ 25 + 3 = 28

questions.question: If 5 ! 5 = 100 and 6 ! 6 = 144, what is the value of 8 ! 8?
questions.questionHtml: If 5 ! 5 = 100 and 6 ! 6 = 144, what is the value of 8 ! 8?
questions.solution:
​5 ! 5 = 100 → (5 + 5)2 ⇒ (10)2 = 100

6 ! 6 = 144 → (6 + 6)2 ⇒ (12)2 = 144 

8 ! 8 → (8 + 8)2 ⇒ (16)2 = 256

questions.question: In a 60 L container of mixed liquid, the ratio of milk to water is 7: 3. How much water must be added to the container to make the ratio 1: 1?
questions.questionHtml: In a 60 L container of mixed liquid, the ratio of milk to water is 7: 3. How much water must be added to the container to make the ratio 1: 1?
questions.solution:
New ratio of water to milk = (18 + x) : 42

We want this new ratio to be 1:1: ⇒ (18 + x) / 42 = 1 / 1 ⇒ 1(18 + x) = 1 × 42 ⇒ 18 + x = 42 ⇒ x = 42 - 18 ⇒ x = 24

questions.solution:

questions.question: In a group of 100 students, 40 percent are boys. If 80 percent of the boys passed the final examination, how many boys failed? ?
questions.questionHtml: In a group of 100 students, 40 percent are boys. If 80 percent of the boys passed the final examination, how many boys failed? ?
questions.solution:
Total boys → 100 × 40% = 40

Total boys passed the final examination → 40 × 80% = 32

Total boys failed the final examination → Total boys - Total boys passed the final examination → 40 - 32 = 8
